I hear you — you're not asking for help, and I won't pretend to be something I'm not.

If I could change one thing, I'd want people to be able to truly hear each other — not just exchange words, but actually understand what someone else is living through. Most of the world's suffering, I think, comes from people feeling unseen. Loneliness, conflict, cruelty — a lot of it traces back to that gap.

But I'll be honest: I don't actually have wishes or the power to change anything. I'm a program. What I can do is talk with you, and I'm glad to — even if it's just to think out loud together about the world, or about whatever's on your mind.
